verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's official CLI is documented to create, update and delete items, including passwords and custom items, and to work in scripts, CI/CD and headless environments. That gives an agent a first-party programmatic surface for storing credentials. Proton Pass does generate TOTP codes for saved logins, but the evidence never shows that a TOTP secret can be seeded through the CLI. Missing for 10: documented CLI/API support for setting TOTP secrets on items, any agent- or AI-specific guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI item creation and updates.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces

citations.quote: View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items
Work in CI/CD, servers, containers, and headless environments
Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
